title: Core: AS2 typeof with all types
description: Test typeof operator with all possible AS2 types: typeof undefined, typeof null, typeof 42, typeof 'string', typeof true, typeof {}, typeof [], typeof function(){}, typeof undeclaredVar. Verify ActionTypeOf (0x44) is emitted. Test typeof in conditional: if (typeof x == 'undefined') {}. Test typeof in assignment: var t = typeof x.
